result.summary: The image shows a typical urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacking buffers from moving traffic. Parked vehicles along both curbs create significant visual obstructions for pedestrians wishing to cross the two-lane roadway.

hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.

result.summary: This residential mid-block environment features row houses with a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to the roadway. The lack of a physical buffer or street trees, combined with sidewalk obstructions like utility poles and personal items, creates a less-than-ideal pedestrian experience.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is positioned directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to deviate from their path.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Clutter
hazards.description: Personal items including a chair and a grill are placed on the sidewalk, further narrowing the available walking space.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk in front of the blue and pink houses

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or planting strip between the narrow sidewalk and the travel lane, increasing exposure to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the sidewalk edge

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to meet modern accessibility standards and provide a clear path around utility poles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees or low-level vegetation to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the nearest intersections to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The street provides continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures. The presence of on-street parking and a wide, straight roadway suggests a risk of higher vehicle speeds and limited visibility for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points visible along this stretch of the road, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without protection.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking lanes on both sides of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns at intersections or mid-block locations to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential and commercial area.

result.summary: The image depicts a typical residential row-house street with a continuous and well-maintained sidewalk. While the sidewalk provides a dedicated space for pedestrians, the lack of a buffer from the roadway and the presence of parked vehicles create potential visibility hazards for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians who might step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, red SUV parked along the curb.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce safety and security after dark.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the road, while also providing shade and improving the aesthetic environment.
